description: Ranks the players you send for a men's T20 fantasy team, with a captain and vice-captain, from each player's own record before the match. On 236 men's matches played after its training data (1 Jul to 17 Sep 2026), its top six held 39.4% of the real top six (random 27.3%) and its captain finished in the real top three 28.8% of the time (random 13.6%). Per call.

is_chase.description: Accepted for older callers and not used: it made the ranking worse when tested.

players.description: 4 to 30 player names as match records write them, e.g. "V Kohli" (both elevens, usually). Names it does not know are listed back in `not_recognised`.

venue.description: Accepted for older callers and not used: it made the ranking worse when tested.

name: hsh-cricket-fantasy-picks
